title: What stands atop Thiruparankundram hill is a survey pillar, ascertains Tamil Nadu government report
description: This report has evoked interest against the backdrop of the latest dispute over the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam atop Thiruparankundram hill, which has taken centre stage, following the Supreme Court’s decision to permit the lighting of the lamp at the newly identified deepathoon as a limited, one-time arrangement
